segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: Delivers commercial banking products and services to small and medium-sized businesses, business owners, executives, professionals, and high net worth individuals.
segments.evidence: We conduct our commercial banking operations through one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest income from loans and leases to commercial clients, plus fees from treasury, retirement and trust services.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn interest income from these loans, generally at variable rates higher than those of our traditional commercial loans.
